case.title: Board View has no Density control; Card size sits beside Column Selection
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Location-A} has at least one technician and one work order.
    For example: Esther Howard.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" empty, no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar between the filters and the display switcher.
  2. Click "Column Selection".
  3. Press Escape.
  4. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  5. Click the density button in the toolbar.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no density button. "Card size" sits beside "Column Selection" between the toolbar's two dividers.
  • Step 2: the picker of card fields opens, the same picker "Fields to display" opened before.
  • Step 3: the picker closes and the cards keep their usual spacing.
  • Step 4: Tech View shows, and its toolbar still has the density button.
  • Step 5: the menu offers "Compact", "Regular" and "Comfortable".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician), SV-10048 (Story 5, Column Selection) and SV-10049 (Story 6, Density); ticket SV-11580

  • S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control (SV-11580). Its spacing control is Card size (S3-R11a), which sits beside Column Selection between the toolbar’s two dividers, as in the design.”
  • S5-R2: “Board View offers a separate Column Selection picker in the same toolbar position and with the same interaction as the column chooser.”
  • S6-E1: “Density applies to Tech View rows on Work Orders; Board View card spacing follows Card size (S3-R11a). List keeps today’s row size, and other application tables are unchanged.”
  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has Card size instead (S3-R11a).”
  • PRD change log, 20 Oct 2026: “Fields to display renamed Column Selection everywhere it appears, the same name the other views use. v71.”

Last checked against build v26.43.0-ffea43c (production) on 10/22/2026.

S3-R11, S6-R1, S6-R3 and S6-E1 above are quoted from PRD version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026, after Card size (SV-11581) passed QA on 29 Oct 2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
